title: Instance registry contract
description: The registry of known instances of the method: one list, whatever the status. 'document' is the path of the instance's method document relative to that document's own repository root; it stays outside this material. 'sha256' pins the document when the instance was executed. Contract by status: an executed entry carries document, sha256, locator and number_format, none of them null; a designed entry keeps the four null or absent. This schema states that contract and does not enforce it (the stdlib mini-validator applies no if/then): the validator enforces it under p-contract-shape.

locator.description: Where an adopter can find the document: a path relative to the root of this material (the directory that contains instances/, so a cell kept in the material is instances/<id> and a sibling cell is ../sibling-cell — no leading slash), or the string 'owner-held, not distributable' when the owner keeps it. Required on an executed entry; null or omitted only while the instance is designed.

number_format.description: How the numbers of the method document are written: point-decimal (1,200.5) or comma-decimal (1.200,5). Each token of the document is read in this format only. Null or omitted only while the instance is designed; the validator reports an executed instance without it under p-contract-shape (there is no silent default).

method_version.description: Optional: the version of the method the instance was executed under. An executed cell is history: it runs under that version's validator, and under a later one only after a migration (the migration notes of the changelog).
